en: The family checked on the swallow every day. As its leg grew stronger, it hopped across the yard and finally flew back to the eaves. In autumn, the swallows prepared to leave for warmer lands.

형은 제법 그럴듯하게 고개를 끄덕였어요. 하지만 지게 위 볏단은 걸음마다 사각사각 소리를 냈지요. 맞은편에서는 동생의 볏단도 똑같이 대답하고 있었어요.
en: The moon climbed high. The older brother tightened the straps on his carrying frame and adjusted his straw shoes. Across the village, the younger brother was getting ready too. This time, both chose the short path through the middle.
“Straight there and back tonight. Soft steps. Nice and slow. Even the wind will not know I am here!”
He nodded proudly at his clever plan. But the rice leaves on his back rustled with every step. From the other direction, his brother's bundle was making exactly the same sound.
